## User workflow / problem

Who needs this, and what are they trying to do?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the outcome without assuming a particular implementation.

## Platform and capability constraints

Which target platforms are involved? What permissions, OS APIs, hardware or compatibility limits are known?

## Privacy and security considerations

What data or device access is involved? Is the capability local-first and user-controlled?
